messages:
maya: Heads-up onboarding OrpheusX-mini (int4). Seeing two issues after conversion: head-stride interleave (KV-cache drift after ~10 tokens) and punctuation id aliasing causing summarize quality drop. Dropping triage notes.
ivan: Quick numbers and the conversion command?
maya: fp16 ppl 1.90, int4 before fixes ppl 3.40. convert run: 
``npython tools/convert.py --src orpheusx --dst gemma --quant int4 --vocab-map maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct.json --out /tmp/orp
```
Small tokenmap excerpt: {"45":"45","46":"900","47":"47"}  # id 46 mapped -> 900 (unexpected appended cluster)
priya: That 900 smells like exporter appended a cluster. Head layout?
maya: Dumped rotary heads (fp32) and ran quick perm infer. Observed even-odd interleave: perm = list(range(0,H,2)) + list(range(1,H,2)).
ivan: Try reordering heads before quant and normalize the punct mapping. Perm snippet used: 
``nH = num_heads
perm = list(range(0,H,2)) + list(range(1,H,2))
# apply tensor = tensor[perm]
```
maya: Applied head reorder + fixed maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct.json (46->46). After re-run int4 ppl 1.96, ROUGE-L recovered near fp16.
sara-bot: ticket INF-3099 created: "OrpheusX-mini head-stride + vocab-alias" assigned to maya (P2).
ivan: Can we add conversion flags --fix-headstride and --validate-vocab-shadowing and a CI seed test (16 tokens) that fails if attention-position correlation drops >8% vs fp16?
maya: Will PR tools/check_head_permutation.py, tools/check_vocab_shadow.py, add --fix-headstride/--validate-vocab flags, and include exporter_git_sha in model metadata. Will attach before/after dumps and small heatmap artifact.
priya: Also add onboarding checklist item: dump first 8 rotary heads and check punctuation cluster range before shipping.
maya: Will do and open PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
